Cost: 10,000eb (Super Luxury)
Class: EQ Sniper Rifle
Range: Anti-Matieral Rifle
Pre-installed: Smartgun Link, Sniper Rifle Rechamber, Sniper Long Barrel, Sniping Scope, Tech Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)

Can't take Capacity attachments. Fires Improved Smart ammo as though it had a Smart Rebuild. Its Tech Rebuild shows rough target outlines through one layer of Thin or Thick Cover. Aimed Shots deal +1d6 (7d6). While charged, the Tech Rebuild halves SP but can't penetrate cover. A successful charged Tech attack with Improved Smart ammo grants a free second attack (as ROF 2, no ammo used, may be Aimed) at a different target within 10m/yds. After a charged Tech attack last Round, it charges without a Move Action. Counts as Silenced when mounted to a vehicle or similar power source. Only a Tech with Maker Rank 7+ can modify or fabricate it.

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
